
## Computing correlation between 

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

clip_probs = pd.read_csv('data/probability_estimates/clip_probs.csv')
spose_49_probs = pd.read_csv('data/probability_estimates/spose_49_probs.csv')
spose_66_probs = pd.read_csv('data/probability_estimates/spose_66_probs.csv')
srf_probs = pd.read_csv('data/probability_estimates/srf_probs.csv')
agg_5plus = pd.read_csv('data/probability_estimates/agg_5plus.csv')
human_probs = agg_5plus[['id_a', 'id_b', 'id_c', 'prob_a', 'prob_b', 'prob_c']]
```

```{python}
dfs = {
    "clip": clip_probs,
    "spose49": spose_49_probs,
    "spose66": spose_66_probs,
    "srf": srf_probs,
    "human": human_probs
}

cols = ["prob_a", "prob_b", "prob_c"]

# Flatten each DataFrame into one vector
vectors = {
    name: df[cols].to_numpy().flatten()
    for name, df in dfs.items()
}

# Compute pairwise correlations
corr_matrix = pd.DataFrame({
    name1: {
        name2: np.corrcoef(v1, v2)[0, 1]
        for name2, v2 in vectors.items()
    }
    for name1, v1 in vectors.items()
})

print(corr_matrix.round(3))
```

```{python}
sns.heatmap(
    corr_matrix,
    annot=True,
    fmt=".3f",
    cmap="coolwarm",
    vmin=-1,
    vmax=1,
    square=True
)

plt.title("Correlation Between Probability Distributions")
plt.show()
```
